decisions.rationale: Valid high: the r6 Dockerfile layer-caching q27 decided on the Fast-skimmed image-layers topic and echoed its formative 'o2 good order'. Fixed: the current gift has no Dockerfile item; q27 is now a React 401/403 handleStatus trace on handling-401-and-403-redirect-and-sign-out (taught in full S34/FT19). Blueprint no longer mentions image-layers or multi-stage-builds (0 matches), and md Skim rule says 'with no exception'. Latest same-role recheck (loop2-critic-sme-recheck, bound to d7b32ef2) marks it resolved with the key re-executed.

Valid: the r6 q27 .dockerignore distractor was an arguable second key with false feedback. Fixed by removing the whole item in r7; the current q27 has a single correct option (C), confirmed by the SME loop-1 and loop-2 rechecks and by reading the code: the 401||403 branch calls forgetUser and redirects with state.from, and the stated sign-in ending returns her to /admin/refunds, so the 403 loops.

Not acted on. Verified q20 line 252 still reads '(c) a network failure, so that no response arrives'. A network failure means no response by definition, so the clause defines the case; it is not an extra hint. The item's discrimination rests on (a) and (b): rejecting the HTML-parse-rejects and 404-as-payment distractors needs the content-type and ok checks. The critic executed all three cases under Node 24 and every key and feedback line is correct. Severity low, the SME critic called it non-blocking in both rechecks and found the author's rejection reasonable, and rewording an accepted, executed-correct item would reopen the bank for no change in validity.

Not acted on. Verified q02 distractor A feedback 'Version 3 is taken: two migration files would share it, so Flyway stops instead of applying a new change' is accurate: Flyway refuses duplicate versions ('Found more than one migration with version 3') and does not apply the change. The critic confirmed key and all feedback against the schema-migrations-with-flyway page. Saying when it fails is optional precision in post-answer feedback, not a validity, key or cueing defect. Low, non-blocking per the SME rechecks; no churn on an accepted item.

Not acted on. Verified q28 options are the {localhost, api} x {9090, 8080} grid. The SME critic itself judged it a structural echo, not a near-duplicate: the deciding step (bundle served by the web container but executed in the laptop browser, so it needs the published host port) is not in formative 'o3 host or container port', and remembering that formative answer does not settle that step. All four feedback lines are correct. Low, non-blocking, and replacing a distractor would reopen an accepted item for marginal gain.

Valid and informational (no bank change recommended): q03/q15/q17/q18 partial overlaps with formative items are integrated items with a real second step. The md Duplication section now says near-duplicate judgement belongs to the critic files and their rechecks, which record this acceptance. SME loop-1 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid and informational: records the critic's own execution of q09-q11, q16-q18, q20 and confirms the q09 fact is taught. No change required; the md verification list records the critic re-execution. SME loop-1 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid: sibling objectives used by q16, q18, q26, q29 and q30 were missing. Fixed: the current blueprint lists let-const-and-equals#o2, destructuring-and-spread#o1, sharing-state-with-context#o1, depends-on-with-health-checks#o2 and github-actions-pipeline#o3 (each present in objectives and coverage), plus handling-401-and-403-redirect-and-sign-out#o2/#o3 for the new q27. SME loop-1 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid: React auth-and-review, taught in full on both tracks, had no item by author choice. Fixed by the new q27 (handling-401-and-403-redirect-and-sign-out o2/o3, present in the blueprint); md now reports 19 of 20 modules with only integration-and-observability excluded, on scope grounds, and drops the author-choice framing. Education loop-1 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid: the F30 overrun precedent was overstated as a repository fact. Fixed: the md now sources the F30 180-minute ledger to the installed Foundation beta taxonomy workbook, states it is not in a repository file, and adds the not-like-for-like caveat (Foundation MCQ weighted 24, this one 0); the coding mix is sourced to the overnight beta mandate, not a repository file. Education loop-1 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid: learner text hard-coded MCQ-first and the order's cost was not argued. Fixed: blueprint instructions now say 'on the proctored Final day' (blueprint sha 323eca54) with no order; md says 'planned as its first sitting' and records the fatigue cost and the owner's option to move the MCQ after the coding or to its own sitting without changing the bank. Education loop-1 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid: no allocation rule recorded. Fixed: md Allocation paragraph states the day-share rule adjusted for Fast-skim and Standard-only exclusions and explains Spring -1 / Python +1 (the residual wording conflict was sfcp-edu-l1-02, also fixed). Education loop-1 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid: the r6 q27 contradicted 'covers content taught in full on both tracks' and the md overclaimed distractor D. Fixed by removing the Dockerfile item and its image-layers/multi-stage objectives from the blueprint (0 matches); the instructions' claim is now true and the md skim rule says 'with no exception'. Education loop-1 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid: the Gate format quote dropped its parenthetical. Fixed: md ledger now quotes 'MCQ + coding assessment (walkthrough recording pending in Evolv)' and states the walkthrough is recorded on S42/FT24, using no Final-day minutes. Education loop-1 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid: the 70 percent mark's consequence was unstated to learners. Fixed: instructions now read 'reported to your assessor as a readiness check against 70 percent; in this beta it does not change your Final grade, which is set by the coding assessments, Project 2 and the other published Final components.' Education loop-1 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid, low: q17 partially overlaps the in-progress HTML/CSS/JS course-final q05 on per-iteration let binding with different setups; the critic called q17 acceptable as is. Fixed at the documentation level the finding asked for: md Release gate now names the q17 / web-final q05 pair as a partial overlap the final whole-set comparison must settle before import. Education loop-1 recheck left it open; the latest education recheck (loop2, bound to gift d7b32ef2) marks it resolved. Gift unchanged by design.

Valid, low: q27 option A's 'not 401' cued q08's 401-vs-403 sub-fact. Fixed: current option A reads 'She stays signed in on /admin/refunds and sees a not-allowed message there.' with no 'not 401'. The stem's 403 premise is the item's setup and taught as the general meaning; q08's deciding fact (default JwtAuthenticationConverter ignores roles) is untouched. SME loop-2 recheck marks it resolved.

Valid, low documentation gap: the md did not say whether the lexical scan was re-run after q27 changed. Fixed: md Duplication section now states 'The scan was re-run on the final r8 bytes with the same corpus' with results (0 exact stem/option matches, 0 shared 7-grams, max Jaccard 0.091). SME loop-2 recheck marks it resolved and confirms q27 is not a near-duplicate.

Valid, medium: r7 q27's stem revealed the sign-in event, killing distractors A and D and leaving o3 untested. Fixed in r8: verified stem now ends 'She opens /admin/refunds, and the API answers 403. Which sequence follows?' with no 'as taught' and no sign-in event; each option states a full sequence, so A tests o3 (no 403 branch) and B vs C tests o2 (replace keeps state.from). Key C is neither longest nor shortest. Education loop-2 recheck marks it resolved; SME loop-2 recheck re-executed the key model.

Valid, low: the r7 allocation sentence said 'weighted toward Spring' while Spring was under its day share. Fixed: md Allocation now states the day-share rule adjusted for skim/Standard-only exclusions and explains Spring sitting about one under (8 of 30) by its excluded topics and module; numbers and rule agree.
